subject: Decision Making
subcategory: Famous Decisions That Changed the World
title: Gorbachev Opens the Soviet Union
description: A short lesson to help you apply Gorbachev Opens the Soviet Union.

hook.text: Gorbachev introduced glasnost and perestroika in 1986. Openness and reform in a system built on secrecy and control.

buildup.text: The Soviet economy was collapsing. Factories produced goods nobody wanted. Corruption was everywhere and hidden.

discovery.text: Glasnost unleashed criticism faster than reforms could address problems.

twist.text: Gorbachev intended to save the Soviet Union. Instead, his reforms accelerated its collapse. Reform killed the patient.

climax.text: Gorbachev shows that reform in a fragile system can trigger collapse.

punchline.text: He tried to save the system. Openness revealed it was already dead.

quiz.question: What unintended consequence did Gorbachev's reforms have?
options: Openness revealed failures so clearly that it accelerated the Soviet Union's collapse
